reason: A web UI plugin that adds a collapsible timeline for locating, previewing, and jumping between user messages in long conversations without modifying session data.

summaries.zh: 为长对话添加可收起的侧边时间轴，用于预览、定位和跳转到用户消息。
summaries.en: Adds a collapsible side timeline for previewing, locating, and jumping between user messages in long conversations.

capabilities: Reads session snapshots and projection data
Provides message previews and navigation within conversations
Scrolls to selected conversation messages and loads older history when needed
